anna_procurement: Quick heads-up — vendor_delta flagged a damaged pallet on the H100 backfill shipment arriving FRA. They've stopped the crate and opened a hold. AWB: 123-4567890. Need RMA plan + whether we can do a partial release for the undamaged units. @vendor_delta can you share photos and the exact SKU counts?

vendor_delta: Photos uploaded to the tracker (link: https://shipper.example/claim/123). Damage looks like pallet collapse, ~6/24 units cosmetically damaged, 2 with bumped connectors. We recommend depot inspection before release.

sam_logistics: Can we split the AWB at FRA and forward the undamaged 18 units to AMS? What's the extra fee to split/repalletize?

vendor_delta: Estimated repalletize + carrier reconsignment = EUR 450. If depot accepts, they can do a local RMA for the 8 units and we can credit replacement parts.

kevin_supply: We need a unit-level cost-offset estimate to decide whether to accept depot repair vs full RMA. Maria — what's our threshold for on-site repairs vs replacement from reserve pool?

maria_ops: Threshold is €1,000 per unit (including logistics). If repair + repalletize < threshold, prefer depot repair. Also we need ETA impact on dedicated cluster provisioning — if we lose 8 units, we fall short for two reserved pools next week.

anna_procurement: Ok, vendor_delta — can you commit to 1) photo evidence in email to customs, 2) reconsign undamaged units within 24h if we approve split, and 3) a provisional credit note for damaged connector units pending depot assessment?

vendor_delta: Yes to all three. We'll send formal email by EOD and initiate provisional credit for 2 connector units (value EUR 12,000 total) pending RMV. Reconsign ETA to AMS: +18h after approval.

shipping_bot: Update: AWB 123-4567890 status changed to "HOLD - FRA" at 2025-09-12T11:24:00Z. Current location: FRA Main Hub. Carrier contact: +49-69-555-0100.

maria_ops: If vendor provides provisional credit and reconsign within 24h, approve split. Sam — coordinate depot inspection team and get photo baseline. Kevin — flag reserve pool topoff for next wave.

sam_logistics: On it. I'll ping depot and book inspection window (slot requested for 2025-09-12 18:00 CET). I'll also request repalletize quote in writing.

kevin_supply: I'll overnight a temporary loan of 4 GPUs from the reserve pool to cover the two reserved capacity pools; we should avoid SLA hit. Will coordinate with billing.

anna_procurement: Thanks everyone. I'll wait for vendor email and credit note, then I'll close the split approval in the tracker.

vendor_delta: Email sent with photos + proforma credit note attached. Reference: DELTA-CLAIM-759.

maria_ops: Confirmed receipt. Closing action: sam to confirm depot inspection outcome before final release (sam_logistics -> DONE when complete).
